meaning.zh:
“富有的” 或 “有钱的”。

这个短语源自19世纪，起初是用来形容那些穿着高级鞋子的人。因为高档鞋子往往代表财富和地位，所以 “well-heeled” 逐渐演变为形容有钱人的代名词。
meaning.en: The phrase originates from the 19th century when it was used to describe someone wearing high-quality shoes. High-quality shoes often indicated wealth and status, so "well-heeled" eventually evolved to become synonymous with being wealthy.

lines.en: The banquet was attended by many *well-heeled* guests.
lines.zh: 许多富有的宾客出席了宴会。

lines.en: Their new restaurant caters to the *well-heeled* crowd.
lines.zh: 他们的新餐馆服务于有钱的顾客。
她来自一个富有的家庭。
